approval: D123 Claude Fable answers, Opus judge
limitations: 95 of 470 eligible LongMemEval-S questions; one run per model.
Histories mix public chat logs with sessions simulated by the dataset authors.
The judge (Opus 5.5) is the same family as the Fable answers it grades, and a different family from mercury-3; prompts written for GPT-4o; not human-checked.
Temperature: API defaults (Claude, not sent) vs 0.5 (mercury-3).
Fable thought adaptively (effort high, 8192 tokens); mercury-3 used reasoning 'low' with 1024 tokens: model and thinking budget both differ.
Budgets use a local token estimate; Claude counts tokens differently.
